- Supports Drive account, quota, app metadata, shared drive, file, permission, label, revision, change, approval, and access proposal workflows.
- Enables file creation, copying, upload/update, export, download, listing, deletion, trash management, and ID generation.
- Includes collaboration actions for comments and replies, including create, list, update, and delete operations.
- Documents safety expectations for read, write, and destructive actions, with schema inspection before running connector payloads.
